verification.finalVisualComparison: verification/visual-review.html compares run-021-v7 original captures with v6 and the reference. Thin curved grass improves the foliage; rocks gain relief but remain too soft, and the upper sleeve folds are overly regular. The main browser route shows shoes supported on the observatory platform. The overall aesthetic objective remains unachieved.
verification.shaderChecks: verification/v7-integration-checks.json and v7-planning/editor-integration.json: tinted skin/cloth/hero materials imported and compiled; current Player log confirms 25 static-batch renderers. Exact CPU star geometry audit passed. Current Web GPU profile verifies saved Starfield GLSL and one draw / 36336 triangles per frame. Whole-scene profile observed979 draws/frame and30.60 FPS; historical v6 profile observed about1030 and34.44. Different assets, route endpoints and sessions prevent isolated optimization claims; fewer calls did not establish an FPS gain.
verification.browserGait: verification/web-v7-gait/capture-manifest.json: actual keyboard/mouse route, completed=true, errors=[]. Original screenshots06-09 show observatory support and stopping outside the instrument. Its recording has transient crop/zoom during screenshots, so continuous animation evidence uses separate video-only sessions. verification/web-v7-gait-video-only/ supplies a screenshot-free flat-ground route; it did not reach the observatory. These samples do not cover every route or pose. Final screenshot-free default-camera W approach in verification/web-v7-observatory-video/ visibly ascends the observatory and stops with both shoes supported before the instrument. The 12.4-second time-cut is byte-identical VP8 packets from original25.600-38.000s, not a performance measurement. Five browser sessions match the final build in verification/web-007-v7/artifact-identity.json.
